## Safety Notes

- Credential behavior: No credentials are required by the catalog row.
- Network access: No network behavior is required unless app code performs it.
- File access: Reads and edits local Apple platform projects when requested.
- Live action risk: Widget work must account for platform availability, signing, privacy, and App Store review constraints.
- MCP, background services, and external binaries remain opt-in; do not auto-start them from this catalog row.
- Secrets, tokens, private keys, connection strings, cookies, OAuth grants, and account IDs must not be committed.
